text:
maria: Heads-up — planning a controlled blue->green traffic shift for edge-router in eu-west tonight at 21:00 UTC. Target: move from 20% green -> 80% green over ~30m after a short canary. Change window 21:00-21:45. Need quick thumbs and confirmation we pin session-sticky routes to the new variant.

deploy-bot: Scheduled job 987654 created. Canary plan: 5% for 5m -> 20% for 10m -> ramp to 80% over 30m. Will emit start/complete messages.

devon: Prewarm green pool? I'll kick warm traffic for 10m at low RPS.

alec: Prewarm started — running prewarm pod: `prewarm-edge-2026-03` (logs streaming). Command I used:
```
kubectl exec -n infra prewarm-edge -- ./warm.sh --target=green --rps=180 --duration=600
```

jen: Quick checklist: healthcheck endpoints ok for green? certs valid? cookie domain and SameSite set? do we need to update LB cookie path? Also confirm throttle/burst limits for the green nodes.

ops-runner: Confirmed certs valid until 2027-01. Healthchecks pass on 3/3 green instances in eu-west. Cookie domain unchanged. I've pinned route metadata for sticky sessions to `2026.03.20-green` so cookie semantics remain consistent.

maria: Nice. Can the traffic router do a probe-weight step and abort on bad signals? We should abort if: 5xx rate > 0.5% sustained for 5m OR p95 latency > 600ms for 3 consecutive 5m windows.

deploy-bot: Rollback triggers configured: `ERROR_RATE>0.005 for 5m` OR `p95>600ms for 15m`. On trigger, automatic fallback to last-known-good (blue) will initiate; manual `rollback` flag respected.

alec: I've added a manual hold command snippet to the ops playbook in case we need an immediate stop:
```
rctl set-weight edge-router eu-west 100 --target=blue  # immediate full rollback to blue
```

devon: I'll watch dashboards and slack alerts. I'll also leave a small probe job running to hit the green variant and validate response shapes.

jen: Quick note on logs: if we see malformed streaming responses, treat it as a quality regression and pause ramp. That was a silent failure mode last time.

ops-runner: Adding a runtime guard: max ramp rate 10% every 3m after initial canary. That should keep queues stable.

maria: Sounds good. Thumbs? :thumbsup:

devon: :thumbsup:

alec: :thumbsup:

ops-runner: I'll be on watch from 20:50-22:00. Will post pre-start and when traffic hits each threshold.

deploy-bot: Reminder: deploy-bot will announce `job 987654 started` at 21:00 UTC. If you want a dry-run, run `deploy-bot simulate 987654` now.

maria: No dry-run, go live. Start prewarm monitoring at 20:45.

ops-runner: Prewarm checks green at 20:47. All good.

deploy-bot: job 987654 started — canary 5% pushed at 21:00 UTC.

devon: Saw the canary. Initial p95 210ms, 5xx=0.02%. continuing.

alec: Watching logs — cookies look fine. No session drops.

maria: Keep an eye on user-facing error alarms and ontrace sampling. If anything odd, call rollback and ping infra oncall.

ops-runner: If we need manual rollback, use: `rctl set-weight edge-router eu-west 100 --target=blue` and then mark incident with tag `router-rollback`.

jen: Noted. Postmortem checklist ready in the channel if we need it.

deploy-bot: Ramp to 20% at 21:05 complete. Next ramp schedule in 10m.

devon: p95 240ms, 5xx 0.03% — all within thresholds.

maria: All right — proceeding to slow ramp to 80% as planned. I'll stay by for the whole window.

ops-runner: 80% reached at 21:40, healthchecks stable. Monitoring for 15m before marking job complete.

deploy-bot: job 987654 complete — final state: 80% green, 20% blue.

maria: Great work. We'll leave the pin for 24h and then reassess for full flip. Thanks everyone. :coffee:

devon: I'll keep an eye on error budget and p95 through the night.

alec: Logging a follow-up note to the release notes doc: `edge-router eu-west partial shift -> 80% green at 21:40 UTC (2026-03-20)`.

jen: Added rollback summary and thresholds to the release notes.

ops-runner: Closing watch. No incidents. :white_check_mark:
